description: Phase 66 loss fixture: a prepared Rome-Greece campaign receives a deterministic opponent-attributed unit loss after its baseline and can exhaust only from the engine loss counter.
luaCommands: lua cmd local rome=find.player(4); local greece=find.player(5); local roma=nil; local athens=nil; for c in rome:cities_iterate() do if c.name == "Roma" then roma=c end end; for c in greece:cities_iterate() do if c.name == "Athens" then athens=c end end; edit.change_city_size(athens, 8, greece); organic_history_bootstrap_create_units(rome, nil, roma.tile, 4, {"AttackFastStartUnit", "AttackStrongStartUnit", "Hut", "FirstBuild"}); organic_history_bootstrap_create_units(rome, roma, roma.tile, 3, {"DefendGoodStartUnit", "DefendGood", "DefendOkStartUnit", "DefendOk", "FirstBuild"}); organic_history_bootstrap_create_units(greece, nil, athens.tile, 20, {"DefendGoodStartUnit", "DefendGood", "DefendOkStartUnit", "DefendOk", "FirstBuild"}); if rome:gold() < 300 then edit.change_gold(rome, 300 - rome:gold()) end; edit.ai_strategy_set_organic(rome, "prepare", "city", greece, athens, 1000, 8000, 1200, game.current_turn() + 2, 166002, -1); edit.make_contact(rome, greece)

lua cmd function phase66_inject_combat_loss(turn) if turn == 2 then local rome=find.player(4); local greece=find.player(5); local victim=nil; for unit in rome:units_iterate() do local nonmil=false; if unit.utype ~= nil then local ok,value=pcall(function() return unit.utype:has_flag("NonMil") end); nonmil=ok and value end; if not nonmil then victim=unit; break end end; if victim ~= nil then edit.unit_kill(victim, "killed", greece) end end end; signal.connect("turn_begin", "phase66_inject_combat_loss")
name: phase66_loss_exhaustion_spike
